gloss: forcibly, by force, against one's will

definitions.gloss: forcibly, by force, against one's will
definitions.explanation: Doing something by force or compulsion, without regard for objections, difficulty, or resistance.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}やり{食|た}べさせた。
{無理|むり}やり{ドア|どあ}を{開|あ}けた。
{嫌|いや}がっているのに{無理|むり}やり{参加|さんか}させるのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not good to force someone to participate when they don't want to.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written as {無理矢理|むりやり}. The hiragana-kanji mix {無理|むり}やり is more common in everyday writing.

FORMATION:
{無理|むり} (unreasonable) + やり (doing). Literally "doing something unreasonable."

NUANCE:
Always carries a negative connotation of using excessive force or ignoring resistance. Stronger than {強引|ごういん} (pushy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無理|むり}やり{連|つ}れていく: to drag someone along
- {無理|むり}やり{押|お}し{込|こ}む: to cram in forcefully
- {無理|むり}やりやらせる: to force someone to do it
- {無理|むり}やり{笑|わら}う: to force a smile
